A '''Sub-Zero Parka''' was an article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] readily available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was found for sale in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] for two hundred and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWS" />
